name: Verbatik
description: Verbatik is a cutting-edge platform that specializes in AI-driven transcription services. It offers users the ability to convert audio and video content into accurate text, making it an essential tool for professionals in various industries such as media, education, and legal sectors. With its advanced algorithms, Verbatik ensures high-quality transcriptions that save time and enhance productivity.

events.d: Converts text into natural-sounding speech audio.
